title: Clawd X Digest
summary: Elon Musk Outlines Grok 4.8 RL Timeline: xAI founder Elon Musk confirms Grok 4.8 (2.5T parameter model) trained on a custom C++ software stack will finish base training this week and enter reinforcement learning.

Trump Slams Anthropic as Enterprise Partners Limit Model Usage: President Trump criticizes Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei over AI slowdown calls while tech and defense partners including NVIDIA, Palantir, and the Pentagon move to limit Anthropic model integration.
Trump Agrees to Crypto Clarity Act Ethics Provisions: Bipartisan momentum accelerates as President Trump officially agrees to ethics provisions in the landmark Crypto Clarity Act framework.

India Rejects BRICS Currency Swap for Chinese Yuan: India officially declines the BRICS proposal to replace US Dollar transactions with the Chinese Yuan, reinforcing its position on monetary sovereignty.

items.title: @elonmusk: Elon Musk Outlines Grok 4.8 & Model Roadmap
items.body: Elon Musk announces that Grok 4.8, a 2.5-trillion parameter model built with xAI's custom C++ software stack, completes base training this week before starting reinforcement learning (RL). He added Grok 4.7 matches Opus 5.0, while Grok 4.9 aims for Astra/Fable class capability.

items.title: @WatcherGuru & @unusual_whales: Corporate & Defense Partners Restrict Anthropic Models
items.body: President Trump criticizes Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei for advocating AI slowdowns, as major industry and defense leaders including NVIDIA, Palantir, Booz Allen Hamilton, and the Pentagon report plans to limit Anthropic model integration.

items.title: @jukan05: Anthropic Financials Reveal >80% Gross Margins
items.body: Financial disclosures reveal Anthropic achieves >80% gross margins prior to revenue sharing with partners like Amazon and model training costs, as the firm targets consecutive quarterly profitability.

items.title: @alexandr_wang: MSL Unveils Muse Agent & Spark Model Lineup
items.body: Scale AI founder Alexandr Wang shares the architectural vision behind MSL's Muse Spark models (1 through 1.3), designed specifically to power personal superintelligence agent @Muse.

items.title: @hwchase17: Domain-Specific Harnesses in Agent Engineering

items.title: @mattpocockuk: Cultivating Internal AI Champions in Engineering

items.title: @WatcherGuru: Trump Signs Off on Crypto Clarity Act Ethics Terms
items.body: President Trump officially agrees to new bipartisan ethics provisions for the Crypto Clarity Act, unlocking key legislative momentum for US digital asset regulation.

items.title: @ChinaTruth: India Rejects BRICS Currency Proposal to Replace Dollar
items.body: India formally rejects the BRICS coalition proposal to substitute Chinese Yuan for US Dollar settlements, signaling strong commitment to independent currency strategy.
